full.contact_note: Actual ground-contact count>0 AND upward force>5N; ineligibility alone is not flight

core.contact_note: Actual ground-contact count>0 AND upward force>5N; ineligibility alone is not flight

point_count_definition: Ground points with individual normal force >5N; count>0 is distinct from count>0 AND aggregate upward Fz>5N eligibility
force_definition: Recorded summed ground normal force vectors in N; not friction force
limitations: One reused baseline episode and one new nominal candidate episode of the same frozen actor; no statistical stability certification.
Kp250 is zero-shot deployment; PPO was trained with Kp500/Kd10. The candidate is not retrained.
Different adapter wrapper hashes are disclosed and independently checked; both retain the same SHA-pinned legacy evaluator and dependencies.
Historical training/evaluation drift hashes differ, equally for both episodes; never claim training and evaluation code were identical.
Zero thresholded contact count is not proof of geometric separation or flight; weak contacts cannot be recovered.
50Hz subsampling can alias native200Hz contact switches; boundary run lengths are censored lower bounds.
Post-core tail is not the maneuver core. Full tracking beyond the locked reference is unavailable rather than time-aligned or fabricated.
No measured robot mass or recorded wheel vertical velocity is available; force remains N, no inferred mg or position-derived wheel velocity.

notes: Official MJCF/STL assets are preserved; generated robot.xml changes only meshdir, names the floating root joint, and adds IK/display sites.
left/right_wheel sites are wheel hinge centers, not human ankle frames; left/right_knee sites are actual knee joint centers.
left/right_contact are nominal local bottom markers: they rotate with the wheel and are NOT rolling contact points or reliable ground clearance. Compute clearance from collision geometry instead.

Official MJCF and Isaac USD share link offsets and joint axes, but are not numerically identical dynamics models. MJCF base includes fixed IMU mass; wheel collision axial width is 0.010m versus 0.050m in USD, and lateral collision offsets are +/-0.008m versus +/-0.00707m.
Official MJCF wheel motor ctrlrange is +/-40Nm, while the imported USD drive maxForce is 80. Other collision primitives also differ; no cross-engine contact or actuator equivalence is implied.
Mink IK playback does not validate contact forces, balance, jump actuation, self-collision avoidance, or dynamic feasibility. No Isaac assets or runtime are changed.

validation.note: Geometric/FK checks only. Contacts include margin contacts and do not prove dynamically feasible balance or jumping.
